title: Trail notes
body:
Trail notes

Went out early, before the parking lot filled up.

Conditions

Creek was high. The crossing is not passable in boots right now.
  • Boardwalk: dry
  • Blue loop: two inches of water
  • Ridge: muddy but fine above the switchbacks

Next time

Start an hour earlier and bring the other camera.

title: Packing list
body:
Packing list

For anything longer than about four miles.
  • Two liters of water
  • Paper map
  • Headlamp
  • Rain shell

title: Trail notes
body:
Second visit. Water down about a foot, crossing is fine now.

Saw three herons at the far end of the boardwalk.

Steps to reserve a campsite

  1. Check the release date
  2. Log in the night before
  3. Refresh at seven exactly
